lemmas.primary_translation: according to what / based on what

definitions.text: innleder en leddsetning som uttrykker en antakelse
definitions.translation: introduces a subordinate clause that expresses an assumption

examples.no: etter det de forteller, er han frisk nå
examples.en: according to what they say, he is well now

examples.no: etter det jeg har hørt, har hun flyttet til Spania
examples.en: according to what I have heard, she has moved to Spain
